game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the forge anvil.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the forge anvil. Each round, a new ember crystals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 290 points of ember crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 290, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Geyser Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 290 within 76 seconds.
